title: POET at the lit phone booth: walk up, lift the handset, dial, talk, hang up (far)
about: He calls his mother from a lit booth on the quay (poem 09 movement "Tears, an abyss"). Profile, facing right; near hand on the handset, far hand dials and then presses flat on the booth wall.
image_paths: relative to this clip file (../../../ == shots/)

states.visible: he walks up the quay into the lit booth; the door stands open
near hand reaches the handset on its cradle; the hand closes on the handle
handset lifted on an arc to his ear; head tips into it
far hand points and presses three keys
he talks: mouth swaps on the beat, brows go sad then raised; far palm flat on the wall
handset back onto the cradle; the hand lets go

contacts.what: near hand grips the handset handle
far palm pressed flat on the booth wall

hand_wants.why: palm pressed on the booth wall
